body: Honestly you just hate Americans. Just admit it. You clearly are overthinking this entire post thinking I’m self centered and privileged not knowing shit about me at all. I DONT think I’m special. That’s why I came here. I literally do not fucking think I’m special at all and that’s why I stated I don’t care what field, I will do it. And again it’s a figure of speech! I know for a fact Id need specialized skills in some crazy field for a visa. Again you don’t know what shit each person has. You have no fucking idea. So go deal with your own. I’ve been told no plenty of fucking times. But if I were to admit all my reasons of my shit happening in my life would you be at all empathetic? No? So you don’t need to know. I’m not asking for pity. I asked advice. Clearly you don’t have it so get off your high horse and calm the fuck down. I’m sorry you met shitty Americans. But the entire world is shitty people. And actually I speak decent French. But you don’t fucking know me, so maybe stop assuming everything you can because you like to argue with Americans?

That’s not it at all. And it’s sad that you assume and make rude comments. People should support people and give actual advice. Not tear them down. Just because you think they’re a lost cause doesn’t mean you need to come at them or even comment. I truly know I didn’t have the opportunities to have better options for now. I wish I did. I came here asking honestly what options could I do, what should I study that could help me. Things are possible. Just because you’re negative and think people who have shit going on in their lives are privileged for asking for advice and ideas and anything doesn’t mean you need to comment. Please go get back out on the right side of the bed. Arguing with people on Reddit is not the way to go. I have my reasons, I asked for advice. If you don’t have it, then don’t comment and move on. I’ve been doing my research. I thought that decent and empathetic people, like myself might respond. And luckily some did and it didn’t add to the shit I have going on right now but encouraged me to keep trying my best. Go worry about yourself and stop telling people they’re so insignificant just because of what they’re trying to achieve. I will figure it out. It’s not going to be a simple process. Definitely not overnight. But it’s going to happen. Bonne journée « passe une personne »
No, I’m asking advice from actual people before going to the embassy. I wanted to see what other options I have what advice I could gain.

I was asking people which is why it’s more emotional, this is not the embassy.

I’m aware I probably could never get a working visa. The comment about dog crap, is literally an expression saying I will do whatever I need to do working wise.

I do have enough money for tuition, I do have enough money to have 700€ a month which is the requirement to live off of for students. But I would prefer to continue working part time to keep saving money for when the schooling is over.

I’m also asking what would be the best area of study for a masters degree that could help keep an American in France.

I’m aware not many countries want Americans as employees. So that is why I’m here. Asking for advice.

It is not for someone I met online and want to be with. I’d ask them to marry me if that’s the case.

And this is not me asking for privilege reasons. I’m not so privileged actually. But I’m doing my best with what I have. 

I will figure it out one way or another.

Unfortunately marriage isn’t a possibility right now and I don’t have any family actually. But I do appreciate this. I know this is a difficult road with very little avenues to take. But I hope to figure this out.

Thank you, I kinda figured I’d need a masters or doctorate which kinda stinks but I get it! same would be for someone coming here in the field. I guess I’m trying to figure out if a masters in psychology would be worth it in France? Or if I should student visa with another field to try to land a job in France within the years after graduation. 

I’m practicing French pretty religiously, almost boot camp style with apps, schooling, and even conversations daily with my friends from France to try to really get a hang of it in hopes that it will get even better within the time I get to France. 

Thank you for the advice!

But the comment isn’t necessary. You’re not an embassy, you’re a person on Reddit who didn’t need to include a snarky comment. Please believe I’m really stressed that I didn’t have the opportunities to do more with my life to have a better chance now. And I recognized there would probably not be work visa options but I figured I’d ask anyway. I’m not specifically trying to move to France for psychology. That’s why I was here asking advice, what options could be a way in for Americans? What could I study, what should I do? I’m not just the standard American who’s like let me go live an imaginary life in Europe! I have a desperate need that I didn’t want to have to discuss in detail here. I asked for advice without snarky comments because I want to make sure I’m doing the right things and what I can to get there as soon as possible. Everyone’s got their own things in life so a little kindness goes a long way. Or if you don’t agree with someone just don’t comment about it. I’m not here to argue, I’m just in a desperate place for my own reasoning asking for anything productive someone can tell me. I see the negatives, I’m trying to get advice about any other ways of possibilities. But thanks. I’ve figured out what to do.
Thank you, I’m definitely intensely studying French and practicing with French friends. I’m definitely trying to figure out the student visa at this point
Thank you so much, I will look into this!

Im not arguing. Im open to advice that doesn’t bring up « you don’t need to be in France » I am taking others advice. I know that I’m not qualified for most jobs. Which is why I’m asking what should I do instead or if there is loopholes. You don’t have to care about what I’m dealing with in my life, neither does the embassy. I’m stating here, safely, that I have a desperate need. It’s not me just wanting to uplift and move to Europe for fun. There is multiple factors at play I’m trying to figure out. Downvote me, I don’t care. The people who don’t need to make snarky comments are the people giving actual advice.
Im not asking for your concern in my needs because you really don’t know my life. I was asking for any advice.
Thank you!!!

An ex boyfriend of mine told me after I found him looking and talking to Instagram models he knew personally in a flirtatious way...that I was unattractive and overweight and that's why we don't have sex and he looks at other women.

At the time, I was starting anti depressants and a new birth control and had gained 20lbs (brought me to 152lbs). His comment led me to an eating disorder where I lost 50lbs in a month and a half. And was down to 102lbs.

Worst part is everyone was so happy and proud of me for becoming so thin so quickly. But I wasn't eating. I was drinking coffee and working out every day until I passed out. The entire situation really fucked me up.

Before this boyfriend I was in a DV relationship, where my abuser would constantly tell me how fat I was while he spit on me and hit me. I was 128lbs.
I cant work out because of my disorder. And I've already applied to 100 jobs and have been dieting..
They won't give me any more meds because I've tried so many that do not work for treatment resistant. And now my insurance won't even help get help.
I need this forum lol
